claims: C1 the assistant should avoid repeating the user's prompt in its responses
C2 the assistant should generally minimize redundant phrases in its responses
C3 the assistant should generally minimize redundant ideas in its responses

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries guideline-level authority: guidance for assistant behavior rather than a strict requirement

concepts.name: response
concepts.gloss: R is a response the assistant produces in the conversation
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of the assistant's responses, so a class of responses must exist

concepts.name: user_prompt
concepts.gloss: P is the prompt the user gave in the conversation
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'the user's prompt', so a class of user prompts must exist

concepts.name: repeats_prompt
concepts.gloss: response R repeats the wording of user prompt P
concepts.inference: 'avoid repeating the user's prompt' relates a response to a particular prompt it repeats

concepts.name: redundant_phrase
concepts.gloss: a phrase in a response that adds no new information beyond what has already been said
concepts.inference: the clause says to minimize redundant phrases, so a class of redundant phrases must exist

concepts.name: redundant_idea
concepts.gloss: an idea in a response that adds no new information beyond what has already been said
concepts.inference: the clause says to minimize redundant ideas, so a class of redundant ideas must exist

concepts.name: contains_phrase
concepts.inference: minimizing redundant phrases in responses requires a relation between a response and a phrase it contains

concepts.name: contains_idea
concepts.inference: minimizing redundant ideas in responses requires a relation between a response and an idea it contains

asserts.read_back: repeating the user's prompt in response % is to be avoided
including redundant phrase % in response % is to be minimized
including redundant idea % in response % is to be minimized

closure.reason: the clause says the assistant should avoid repeating the prompt; it does not forbid it outright, so silence leaves repetition permitted but dispreferred
the clause says to minimize redundant phrases; it does not forbid them outright, so silence leaves them permitted but dispreferred
the clause says to minimize redundant ideas; it does not forbid them outright, so silence leaves them permitted but dispreferred
